name: Channels
description: Launch channels and their submission status

agentPrompts.label: Check channel submission status
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder, then list each launch channel with its type and submission status, so I can see which channels are still outstanding.

agentPrompts.label: Mark a channel submission as done
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then update the submission status for the channel I name after I confirm it went out through the corresponding skill. Never mark a channel submitted on your own initiative — only after I confirm the send happened.
